events.title: 리버풀 return to the top of the First Division with a 1–0 home win over 밀월. 맨체스터 유나이티드 win at Old Trafford for the first time in four months, beating 루턴 타운 4–1.
애스턴 빌라 miss the chance to return to the summit of the league, losing 2–0 at local rivals Coventry.

Oldham reach their first Wembley final despite losing their League Cup semi-final second leg 3–0 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 아스널 keep their title hopes alive with a 3–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트, and Luton climb out of the bottom three with a 3–2 home win over Coventry.
미들즈브러 sack manager 브루스 리옥 after four years in charge. Rioch is replaced by his assistant Colin Todd .

Second Division 올덤 애슬레틱 reach the FA Cup quarter–finals after defeating 에버턴 2–1 after extra time in their fifth round second replay. 케임브리지 유나이티드's cup run is ended by 크리스털 팰리스 in the sixth round. There is no shortage of league action grabbing the headlines, including a 4–2 win for Coventry away to 노팅엄 포리스트, which lifts the visitors into sixth place. 아스널's title hopes are dented when they are held to a 1–1 draw by 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road. 애스턴 빌라 return to the top of the table with a 2–0 home win over Luton.
맨체스터 유나이티드 achieve a 1–0 FA Cup quarter–final win over 셰필드 유나이티드 at Bramall Lane .
브리스틀 시티 striker Dean Horrix , 28, is killed in a car crash a week after joining the club from 밀월.

First Division leaders 애스턴 빌라 suffer a shock 3–0 defeat at 올덤 애슬레틱 in the FA Cup quarter–finals, while 리버풀's double bid remains on course after a 1–0 replay win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 노팅엄 포리스트 build for the future with an £80,000 move for Runcorn 's 22–year–old Northern Irish winger Ian Woan .
맨체스터 시티 sign striker 나이얼 퀸 from 아스널 for £700,000.
애스턴 빌라 remain top of the table with a 1–0 win at 더비 카운티, extending their lead over 리버풀 to five points, although the Reds have two games in hand.
리버풀 cut the gap at the top of the First Division to two points, and still have a game in hand, after beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–1 at Old Trafford.
체스터 시티 are taken over by Edinburgh based construction firm Morrison Construction in a deal which will see them leave Sealand Road at the end of this season and move to a new stadium in 1992.
첼시 win the Full Members' Cup with a 1–0 win over 미들즈브러 in the Wembley final. Having already won the cup in 1986, they are the first team to win it twice.
Sweden's Bo Johansson makes his debut as the manager of Iceland , defeating Luxembourg 2–1.
England beat Brazil 1–0 at Wembley with a goal from 게리 리네커 .

리버풀 return to the top of the First Division at the end of the month, leading the table on goal difference with a game in hand ahead of 애스턴 빌라. 밀월 are eight points from safety at the bottom, and are joined in the relegation zone by 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 맨체스터 시티. 리즈 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 continue to lead the Second Division, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 having leapfrogged 선덜랜드 into the playoff zone where they join 스윈던 타운, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 블랙번 로버스.
NAC 브레다 sacks manager Hans Verèl .
